translations.idiomatic: At Minister of War Tang Duo's urging, a thousand-household guard and defense post was set up at Xiangwu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，土官知州黃彧遣頭目羅以得貢馬，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, the native magistrate Huang Yu sent a headman named Luo Yide to present tribute horses and was rewarded with paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 2 the native magistrate Huang Yu sent the headman Luo Yide with tribute horses and received paper money in return.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年，故土官知州黃謙昌子宗蔭貢馬，賜鈔。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuande, Zongyin, son of the former native magistrate Huang Qianchang, presented tribute horses and was granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 4, Zongyin, son of the former native magistrate Huang Qianchang, brought tribute horses and was given paper money.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年，田州岑猛叛，向武土官以兵助猛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiajing, when Cen Meng of Tianzhou rebelled, the Xiangwu native official sent troops to assist Meng.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 4, when Cen Meng of Tianzhou revolted, the Xiangwu chieftain marched to his aid.

sentences.zh: 提督盛應期議大征，檄向武出兵討賊，以功贖罪。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi planned a major campaign and ordered Xiangwu to dispatch troops to suppress the rebels, redeeming guilt through merit.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi prepared a full expedition and commanded Xiangwu to join the hunt for rebels, offering remission of guilt for deeds done.

sentences.zh: 十六年，田州盧蘇叛，鎮安土官岑真寶以兵納岑邦佐，蘇求助於向武。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Lu Su of Tianzhou rebelled. The Zhen'an native official Cen Zhenbao welcomed Cen Bangzuo with troops. Su sought help from Xiangwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Lu Su of Tianzhou rose up. The Zhen'an chieftain Cen Zhenbao received Cen Bangzuo with an armed escort, and Su turned to Xiangwu for help.

sentences.zh: 時土官黃仲金怨真寶，遂與合兵，破鎮安。

translations.literal: At that time the native official Huang Zhongjin bore a grudge against Zhenbao, so he joined forces with Su and captured Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiangwu chieftain Huang Zhongjin, who resented Zhenbao, joined Su and together they took Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 事聞，革仲金冠帶。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Zhongjin's official cap and belt were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, Zhongjin lost his cap and belt of office.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以仲金聽調有勞，詔許承襲原職，免赴京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because Zhongjin had rendered service when called to duty, an imperial decree permitted him to inherit his original post and exempted him from traveling to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, for dutiful service when summoned, the throne restored Zhongjin to hereditary office and excused him the journey to court.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，又以剿平瑤寇功，加仲金四品服。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, for further merit in suppressing Yao bandits, Zhongjin was granted fourth-rank official dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year he was rewarded with fourth-rank robes for crushing Yao raiders.

sentences.zh: 向武領縣一，曰富勞，元置。

translations.literal: Xiangwu administered one county, Fulao, established under the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangwu governed a single county, Fulao, which dated to Yuan times.

sentences.zh: 洪武間，為蠻僚所據。

translations.literal: During the Hongwu reign it was occupied by Man and Liao peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu era it had been seized by Man and Liao tribes.

sentences.zh: 建文時復置，仍隸向武州。

translations.literal: It was re-established in the Jianwen era and remained subordinate to Xiangwu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored under Jianwen and again placed under Xiangwu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，省武林入焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle, Wulin was abolished and merged into it.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongle, Wulin was abolished and absorbed into Fulao.

sentences.zh: 土官亦黃氏世襲。

translations.literal: The native officials were also hereditary in the Huang clan.
translations.idiomatic: Its native magistrates too passed in the Huang line.

sentences.zh: 奉議州，宋置。

translations.literal: Fengyi Prefecture was established in the Song.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyi Prefecture was founded in Song times.

sentences.zh: 初屬靜江軍，後屬廣西經略安撫司。

translations.literal: It initially belonged to Jingjiang Army, later to the Guangxi Military Pacification and Comfort Commission.
translations.idiomatic: It first answered to Jingjiang Army, then to the Guangxi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 元屬廣西兩江道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to the Guangxi Two Rivers Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it fell under the Guangxi Two Rivers Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官黃誌威舊為田州府總管，來歸附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the native official Huang Zhiwei, who had formerly been general administrator of Tianzhou Prefecture, came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu the native leader Huang Zhiwei, once general administrator of Tianzhou Prefecture, came over to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 二年詔授其子世鐵為向武州知州，世襲。

translations.literal: In the second year an imperial decree appointed his son Shitie magistrate of Xiangwu Prefecture, with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the throne named his son Shitie magistrate of Xiangwu Prefecture, to be held in succession.

sentences.zh: 三年，誌威入朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhiwei came to court and presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Zhiwei attended court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年招撫奉議等州百十七處人民，皆款服。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he persuaded and pacified the people of Fengyi and 117 other places, all of whom sincerely submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he won over the people of Fengyi and 117 other districts, all of whom came in willingly.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉誌威功，命以安州、侯州、陽縣屬之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Zhiwei's achievements and ordered that Anzhou, Houzhou, and Yang County be placed under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Zhiwei's work and placed Anzhou, Houzhou, and Yang County under his authority.

sentences.zh: 七年以誌威為奉議州知州兼守禦，直隸廣西行省。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Zhiwei was appointed magistrate of Fengyi Prefecture concurrently serving as garrison commander, directly subordinate to the Guangxi Provincial Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Zhiwei became magistrate of Fengyi Prefecture and garrison commander at once, answering directly to the Guangxi provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，奉議州知州黃嗣隆遣人貢馬及方物，賜以鈔錠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Huang Silong, magistrate of Fengyi Prefecture, sent envoys to present horses and local products and was granted ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Fengyi magistrate Huang Silong sent horses and regional goods and received ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，廣西布政司言，奉議、南丹等處蠻人梗化。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Guangxi Provincial Administration Commission reported that barbarians in Fengyi, Nandan, and other places were obstructing assimilation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Guangxi officials reported that tribes in Fengyi, Nandan, and neighboring districts were blocking assimilation.

sentences.zh: 時都督楊文討龍州，伏罪，帝命移兵奉議剿賊，遣使諭文等：「近聞奉議、兩江溪峒等處，林木陰翳，蛇虺遺毒草莽中，雨過，流毒溪澗，飲之令人死。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Commander Yang Wen was suppressing Longzhou; once the enemy had submitted, the emperor ordered him to shift troops to Fengyi to exterminate bandits and sent envoys to instruct Yang and the others: "Recently it has been heard that in Fengyi, the Two Rivers stream grottoes, and other places, the forests are dense and shaded. Snakes and vipers leave poison in the grass; after rain it flows into streams and brooks, and drinking it kills men.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commander Yang Wen was then finishing operations at Longzhou. When the foe had surrendered, the emperor ordered him onward to Fengyi to hunt rebels and sent word: "We have heard that in Fengyi, the Two Rivers gorges, and the like the woods run dark and close. Serpents leave venom in the undergrowth; when rain washes it into the streams, a drink can kill a man.

sentences.zh: 師入其地，行營駐劄，勿飲山溪水泉，恐余毒傷人。

translations.literal: When the army enters that region and encamps, do not drink from mountain streams or springs, lest lingering poison harm the men.
translations.idiomatic: When your columns enter and make camp, do not drink from hill streams or springs, for the residue may still poison your men.

sentences.zh: 宜鑿井以飲，爾等其慎察之。

translations.literal: You should dig wells for drinking water. Take careful heed of this.
translations.idiomatic: Dig wells for your water instead. Take care to heed this.

sentences.zh: 」文發廣西都司及護衛官軍二萬人，調田州、泗城等土兵三萬八千九百人從征。

translations.literal: " Yang Wen mobilized twenty thousand troops from the Guangxi Regional Military Commission and guard units, and mustered thirty-eight thousand nine hundred native soldiers from Tianzhou, Sicheng, and other places for the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wen then raised twenty thousand men from the Guangxi regional command and its guards, and called up thirty-eight thousand nine hundred native troops from Tianzhou, Sicheng, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 師至奉議州，蠻寇聞官軍至，悉竄入山林，據險自固。

translations.literal: When the army reached Fengyi Prefecture, the barbarian bandits, hearing that government troops had arrived, all fled into the forests and held the steep terrain in defense.
translations.idiomatic: At Fengyi the tribes heard the imperial army was coming and scattered into the woods, fortifying the heights.

sentences.zh: 文督諸將分兵捕之，復調參將劉真等領兵分道攻南丹叛寇。

translations.literal: Yang Wen supervised the generals in dividing troops to hunt them down, and also dispatched Brigadier General Liu Zhen and others to lead forces on separate routes against the rebel bandits of Nandan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wen set his generals to divided pursuit and sent Brigadier Liu Zhen and others on separate columns against the Nandan rebels.

sentences.zh: 初，文等駐師奉議州之東南，分兵追捕賊黨，且遣人招降其脅從者。

translations.literal: Initially Yang and the others encamped southeast of Fengyi Prefecture, divided troops to pursue the bandit factions, and also sent men to persuade those who had been coerced to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At first Yang's force camped southeast of Fengyi, sent out parties to run down rebel bands, and dispatched envoys to coax the coerced back to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 賊皆焚廬舍，走山谷，憑險阻立柵自固。

translations.literal: The bandits all burned their dwellings, fled to the valleys, and relied on steep barriers to erect stockades and hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels burned their houses, took to the ravines, and raised palisades on the cliffs.

sentences.zh: 文督將士屢攻破之，賊眾潰散。

translations.literal: Yang Wen supervised the officers and soldiers in repeatedly breaking through them, and the bandit masses scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wen drove his men again and again through their lines until the rebel host broke apart.

sentences.zh: 左副將軍韓觀等遂分兵追討都康、向武、富勞、上林諸州縣，破其更吾、蓮花、大藤峽等寨，斬向武土官黃世鐵並其黨萬八千三百余人，招降蠻民復業者六百四十八戶，徙置象州武山縣，蠻寇遂平。

translations.literal: Left Vice General Han Guan and others then divided troops to pursue and suppress Dukang, Xiangwu, Fulao, Shanglin, and other prefectures and counties, capturing their strongholds at Gengwu, Lianhua, and Dateng Gorge, beheading the Xiangwu native official Huang Shitie together with more than eighteen thousand three hundred of his followers, persuading six hundred forty-eight households of barbarian people to return to their livelihoods, resettling them in Wushan County in Xiang Prefecture. The barbarian bandits were thus pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice General Han Guan and others then fanned out against Dukang, Xiangwu, Fulao, Shanglin, and neighboring districts, storming Gengwu, Lianhua, Dateng Gorge, and other forts. They cut down the Xiangwu chieftain Huang Shitie and more than eighteen thousand three hundred of his men, brought six hundred forty-eight barbarian households back to settled life, and moved them to Wushan County in Xiang Prefecture. The frontier trouble was stilled.

sentences.zh: 時兵部尚書致仕唐鐸參議軍事，以朝廷嘗命征剿畢日，置衛守之。

translations.literal: At that time Tang Duo, retired Minister of War who was advising on military affairs, noted that the court had once ordered that when the campaign of suppression was finished, guard posts should be established for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Duo, the retired Minister of War then advising on the campaign, recalled the court's earlier order to garrison the region once pacification was complete.

sentences.zh: 乃會諸將相度形勢，置奉議等衛並向武、河池、懷集、武仙、賀縣等處守禦千戶所，設官軍鎮守。

translations.literal: He then met with the generals to survey the terrain and established guards at Fengyi and other places, together with guard and defense battalions of a thousand households at Xiangwu, Hechi, Huaiji, Wuxian, Hexian, and elsewhere, setting official troops to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: He and the commanders surveyed the ground and established guards at Fengyi and elsewhere, with thousand-household defense posts at Xiangwu, Hechi, Huaiji, Wuxian, Hexian, and the like, manned by regular garrisons.

sentences.zh: 詔從其言。

translations.literal: An imperial decree approved his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年，署州事土官黃宗蔭遣頭目貢馬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande, Huang Zongyin, who was administering the prefecture as native official, sent a headman to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 2 the acting native magistrate Huang Zongyin sent a headman with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 正統五年，宗蔭科斂劫殺，甚且欲戕其母。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong, Zongyin levied exactions, robbed and killed, and even wished to murder his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 5 Zongyin extorted, plundered, and killed, and at one point tried to kill his own mother.

sentences.zh: 母避之，殺母侍者以泄怒，為母所告。

translations.literal: His mother fled from him. He killed her attendants to vent his rage and was denounced by his mother.
translations.idiomatic: She fled; he slaughtered her attendants in fury, and she brought charges against him.

sentences.zh: 僉事鄧義奏其事，帝敕總兵官柳溥及三司按驗以聞。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Deng Yi memorialized the affair. The emperor ordered Regional Commander Liu Pu and the three commissions to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Deng Yi reported the case. The emperor told Regional Commander Liu Pu and the three commissions to examine it and reply.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年，田州岑猛叛，奉議土官嘗助猛攻泗城州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiajing, when Cen Meng of Tianzhou rebelled, the Fengyi native official had once assisted Meng in attacking Sicheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 4, when Cen Meng of Tianzhou revolted, the Fengyi chieftain had helped him strike Sicheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至是提督盛應期言，許其自新，令出兵討賊，以功贖罪。

translations.literal: At this point Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi stated that he should be allowed to reform and was ordered to dispatch troops to suppress bandits and redeem guilt through merit.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi now urged clemency: let him turn out against the rebels and earn pardon by service.

sentences.zh: 後土官知州死，皆以土判官掌州事。

translations.literal: Later, when the native magistrate died, a native assistant magistrate always administered prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, whenever the native magistrate died, a native deputy handled the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 論者以奉議彈丸地，三面交迫田州，獨南界鎮安，其勢甚蹙。

translations.literal: Commentators observed that Fengyi was a territory no larger than a pellet. On three sides it was pressed by Tianzhou; only to the south did it border Zhen'an. Its strategic position was extremely cramped.
translations.idiomatic: Observers noted that Fengyi was scarcely larger than a pellet, hemmed on three sides by Tianzhou and open to Zhen'an only in the south—a desperately tight position.

sentences.zh: 明初置衛，銓官如宋、元故事，蓋欲中斷田、鎮，以伐其謀雲。

translations.literal: When guards were established at the beginning of Ming and officials were appointed according to Song and Yuan precedent, it was presumably intended to cut between Tianzhou and Zhen'an and thwart their designs.
translations.idiomatic: The early Ming garrisons, with appointments following Song and Yuan practice, were plainly meant to wedge between Tianzhou and Zhen'an and break their schemes.

sentences.zh: 江州界，東抵忠州，西抵龍州，南抵思明，北抵太平府。

translations.literal: The borders of Jiangzhou: to the east it adjoined Zhongzhou, to the west Longzhou, to the south Siming, and to the north Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou's frontiers ran east to Zhongzhou, west to Longzhou, south to Siming, and north to Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其州宋置，隸古萬寨。

translations.literal: The prefecture was established in the Song and was subordinate to Guwan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture was founded in Song times and answered to Guwan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it fell under Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明初，土官黃威慶歸附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, the native official Huang Weiqing submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty the native leader Huang Weiqing came over.

sentences.zh: 授世襲知州，設流官吏目以佐之，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: He was appointed hereditary magistrate, with a regular administrative subordinate appointed to assist him, directly subordinate to the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He received a hereditary magistracy, a regular clerk was named to assist him, and the post reported directly to the provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十二年，以平瑤、僮功，準江州土官子黃恩暫署本職。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Jiajing, for merit in pacifying Yao and Zhuang bandits, Huang En, son of the Jiangzhou native official, was temporarily appointed to his father's office.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 42, for quelling Yao and Zhuang raiders, the Jiangzhou chieftain's son Huang En was allowed to act in his father's place.

sentences.zh: 領縣一，曰羅白。

translations.literal: It administered one county, Luobai.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county, Luobai.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，土官梁敬賓歸附，授世襲知縣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, the native official Liang Jingbin submitted and was appointed hereditary magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu the native leader Liang Jingbin submitted and was made hereditary magistrate.

sentences.zh: 敬賓死，子復昌襲。

translations.literal: When Jingbin died, his son Fuchang succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: After Jingbin's death his son Fuchang inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，從征交阯被陷，子福裏襲。

translations.literal: During the Yongle reign he joined the campaign against Jiaozhi and was captured; his son Fuli succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle he marched on Jiaozhi, was taken captive, and his son Fuli succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 思陵州，宋置，屬永平寨。

translations.literal: Silang Prefecture was established in the Song and belonged to Yongping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Silang Prefecture was founded in Song times and belonged to Yongping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬思明路。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it fell under Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，省入思明府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu it was abolished and merged into Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu it was abolished and absorbed into Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十一年復置思陵州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Silang Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Silang Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，土官韋延壽貢馬及方物。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the native official Wei Yanshou presented horses and local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year the native official Wei Yanshou sent horses and regional goods.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年，護印土官韋昌來朝，貢馬，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuande, Wei Chang, the native official who guarded the seal, came to court, presented tribute horses, and was granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 4 Wei Chang, the seal-keeping native official, attended court with tribute horses and received paper money.

sentences.zh: 正統間，貢賜如制。

translations.literal: During the Zhengtong reign, tribute and rewards followed the established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Zhengtong era tribute and gifts followed the usual rules.

sentences.zh: 其界東至忠州，西北至思明，南至交阯。

translations.literal: Its borders extended east to Zhongzhou, northwest to Siming, and south to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Its bounds reached east to Zhongzhou, northwest to Siming, and south to Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 六年，儋州宜倫縣民陳昆六等作亂，攻陷州城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the people of Yilun County in Danzhou, Chen Kunliu and others, rose in rebellion and captured the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Chen Kunliu and others of Yilun County in Danzhou rebelled and took the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 廣東指揮使司奏言：「近儋州山賊亂，已調兵剿。

translations.literal: The Guangdong Regional Military Commission memorialized: "Recently bandits in the hills of Danzhou have risen in disorder, and troops have already been mobilized to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong regional command reported: "Bandits have lately risen in Danzhou's hills, and troops are already in the field against them.

sentences.zh: 其儋、萬二州，山深地曠，宜設兵衛鎮之。

translations.literal: Danzhou and Wanzhou are deep in mountains and broad in territory; military guards should be established to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: Danzhou and Wanzhou lie in deep hills over wide country; garrisons should be posted to hold them.

sentences.zh: 」詔置儋、萬二州守禦千戶所。

translations.literal: " An imperial decree established guard and defense battalions of a thousand households at Danzhou and Wanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then ordered thousand-household guard posts at Danzhou and Wanzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，儋州黎人符均勝等作亂，海南衛指揮張仁率兵討平之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Fu Junsheng and other Li people of Danzhou rose in rebellion. Zhang Ren, commander of the Hainan Guard, led troops and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Danzhou Li under Fu Junsheng rebelled; Hainan Guard commander Zhang Ren marched out and put them down.

sentences.zh: 又海南羅屯等洞黎人作亂，千戶周旺等討平之。

translations.literal: Also, Li people of the Luotun and other caves in Hainan rose in rebellion; Battalion Commander Zhou Wang and others suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Li raiders from Luotun and other caves in Hainan also rose up; thousand-household Zhou Wang and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 澄邁縣賊王官舍亂，典史彭禎領民兵捕斬之。

translations.literal: The bandit Wang Guanshe stirred disorder in Chengmai County; Clerk Peng Zhen led militia who captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengmai the outlaw Wang Guanshe raised trouble; clerk Peng Zhen led militiamen who ran him down and killed him.

sentences.zh: 十五年，萬、崖二州民陳鼎叔等作亂，陷陵水縣，為海南衛官軍擊敗，追至藤橋，斬鼎叔等三百余人，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Chen Dingshu and others of Wanzhou and Yazhou rose in rebellion, captured Lingshui County, were defeated by troops of the Hainan Guard, pursued to Tengqiao, and more than three hundred including Dingshu were beheaded; the remaining factions were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Chen Dingshu and others of Wanzhou and Yazhou rebelled, seized Lingshui County, were beaten by the Hainan Guard, chased to Tengqiao, and more than three hundred including Dingshu were slain; the rest were cleared away.

sentences.zh: 十七年，儋州宜倫縣黎民唐那虎等亂，海南衛指揮張信發兵討之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Li people Tang Nahu and others of Yilun County in Danzhou stirred disorder, and Zhang Xin, commander of the Hainan Guard, dispatched troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the Yilun Li under Tang Nahu and others rose up, and Hainan Guard commander Zhang Xin sent troops against them.

sentences.zh: 那虎及其黨鄭銀等敗遁，信追擒之，送京師。

translations.literal: Na Hu and his faction Zheng Yin and others were defeated and fled; Xin pursued, captured them, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Na Hu and his followers, including Zheng Yin, were defeated and fled, but Zhang Xin pursued them, captured them, and sent them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 知州魏世吉受賄，縱銀去。

translations.literal: Prefect Wei Shiji accepted bribes and let Yin go.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wei Shiji took bribes and released Zheng Yin.

sentences.zh: 帝謂兵部曰：「知州不能捕賊，及官軍捕至而反縱之乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said to the Ministry of War: "The prefect cannot capture bandits, and when the official army captures them he releases them instead?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Ministry of War, "Can a prefect fail to catch bandits—and then, when the official army has captured them, release them instead?"

sentences.zh: 」命遣力士即其州杖世吉，責捕所縱者。

translations.literal: Ordered strongmen dispatched to his prefecture to beat Shiji with the rod, and charged him to capture those he had released.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered strongmen sent immediately to that prefecture to beat Wei Shiji with the rod and required him to recapture those he had set free.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年，廣東都司言：「瓊州所屬七縣八洞生黎八千五百人，崖州抱有等十八村一千余戶，俱已向化，惟羅活諸洞生黎尚未歸附。

translations.literal: Yongle third year, the Guangdong provincial military command reported: "Among Qiongzhou's seven counties and eight dong are eight thousand five hundred unacculturated Li; Yazhou's Baoyou and other eighteen villages, more than one thousand households—all have already submitted; only the unacculturated Li of Luohuo and other dong have not yet attached."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle, the Guangdong provincial military command reported, "Among the seven counties and eight dong under Qiongzhou are eight thousand five hundred unacculturated Li; in Yazhou, Baoyou and seventeen other villages, more than a thousand households, have all already submitted to the dynasty—only the unacculturated Li of Luohuo and the other dong have not yet come over."

sentences.zh: 」帝命遣通判劉銘賫敕撫諭之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Assistant Prefect Liu Ming dispatched bearing an edict to pacify and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that Assistant Prefect Liu Ming be sent with an imperial edict to win them over and announce the court's will.

sentences.zh: 御史汪俊民言：「瓊州周圍皆海，中有大、小五指，黎母等山，皆生熟黎人所居。

translations.literal: Censor Wang Junmin said: "Qiongzhou is surrounded on all sides by sea; within are the Greater and Lesser Wuzhi, Limu, and other mountains—all dwellings of acculturated and unacculturated Li people."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wang Junmin said, "Qiongzhou is encircled by sea. Within it rise the Greater and Lesser Wuzhi Mountains, Limu Mountain, and others—all home to acculturated and unacculturated Li."

sentences.zh: 比歲軍民有逃入黎洞者，甚且引誘生黎，侵擾居民。

translations.literal: In recent years soldiers and civilians have fled into Li caves; some even incited unacculturated Li and harassed residents.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years soldiers and civilians have fled into Li territory, and some have even incited unacculturated Li to raid settled communities.

sentences.zh: 朝廷屢使招諭，黎性頑狠，未見信從。

translations.literal: The court repeatedly sent people to summon and instruct; the Li nature is stubborn and fierce, and they have not been seen to trust and follow.
translations.idiomatic: The court has repeatedly sent envoys to summon and instruct them, but the Li are stubborn and fierce and have shown little willingness to heed the throne.

sentences.zh: 又山水峻惡，風氣亦異，罹其瘴毒，鮮能全活。

translations.literal: Moreover the mountains and waters are steep and harsh, the climate also different; those who suffer its miasma rarely survive whole.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the mountains and waters are rugged and forbidding, the climate unlike that of the interior, and those who contract its miasmas rarely escape with their lives.

sentences.zh: 近訪宜倫縣熟黎峒首王賢祐、嘗奉命招諭黎民，歸化者多。

translations.literal: Recently it was learned that Yilun County acculturated Li dong chief Wang Xianyou, having once received orders to summon and instruct Li people, had many submit.
translations.idiomatic: It has lately been learned that Wang Xianyou, a dong chief of the acculturated Li in Yilun County, had once been commissioned to win over the Li and had brought many to submission.

sentences.zh: 請仍詔賢祐，量授以官，俾招諭未服，戒約諸峒，無納逋逃。

translations.literal: Request again to decree Xianyou, appoint him to office according to measure, and have him summon and instruct those not yet subdued, warn and bind the various dong, and not harbor fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that Wang Xianyou again be ordered by imperial decree, granted an office commensurate with his standing, and charged to win over those still unsubmissive, restrain the various dong, and refuse to shelter fugitives.

sentences.zh: 其熟黎則令隨產納稅，悉免差徭；

translations.literal: As for acculturated Li, order them to pay tax according to produce and wholly exempt corvée levies;
translations.idiomatic: Acculturated Li should pay tax according to their produce and be wholly exempt from corvée service;

sentences.zh: 其生黎歸化者，免稅三年；

translations.literal: those unacculturated Li who submit, exempt from tax for three years;
translations.idiomatic: unacculturated Li who come over should be exempt from tax for three years;

sentences.zh: 峒首則量所招民數多寡授以職。

translations.literal: dong chiefs should receive office according to the more or less of people they summon.
translations.idiomatic: and dong chiefs should receive offices according to how many people they bring in.

sentences.zh: 如此庶幾黎人順服。

translations.literal: In this way perhaps the Li people may be brought to obedience.
translations.idiomatic: In this way the Li might more readily be brought to obedience.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 遣知縣潘隆本賫敕撫諭。

translations.literal: Sent Magistrate Pan Longben bearing an edict to pacify and instruct.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Pan Longben was dispatched with an imperial edict to carry out the pacification.

sentences.zh: 四年，瓊州屬縣生黎峒首羅顯、許誌廣、陳忠等三十三人來朝。

translations.literal: Fourth year, Qiongzhou subordinate counties' unacculturated Li dong chiefs Luo Xian, Xu Zhiguang, Chen Zhong, and thirty-three others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, thirty-three unacculturated Li dong chiefs from Qiongzhou's constituent counties—including Luo Xian, Xu Zhiguang, and Chen Zhong—came to court.

sentences.zh: 初以生黎多未向化，遣銘招撫。

translations.literal: Initially because many unacculturated Li had not yet submitted, sent Ming to summon and pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because many unacculturated Li had not yet submitted, Liu Ming had been sent to win them over.

sentences.zh: 至是向化者萬余戶，顯等從銘來朝，且乞以銘撫其眾。

translations.literal: By this time those submitted exceeded ten thousand households; Xian and others followed Ming to court, and moreover asked that Ming pacify their multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: By then more than ten thousand households had come over. Luo Xian and the others accompanied Liu Ming to court and asked that he continue to oversee their people.

sentences.zh: 帝遂授銘瓊州知府，專職撫黎，仍授顯等知縣、縣丞、巡檢等官，賜冠帶鈔幣，遣還。

translations.literal: The emperor then appointed Ming Qiongzhou prefect, with exclusive duty to pacify the Li; still appointed Xian and others as magistrates, assistant magistrates, inspectors, and other offices, bestowed caps, sashes, paper money, and silks, and sent them back.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then appointed Liu Ming prefect of Qiongzhou with sole responsibility for pacifying the Li, while granting Luo Xian and the others posts as magistrates, assistant magistrates, and route inspectors, bestowing official caps, sashes, paper money, and silks before sending them home.

sentences.zh: 自是諸黎感悅，相繼來歸。

translations.literal: From this the various Li were moved and pleased, and came to attach in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Li were heartened and came over one after another.

sentences.zh: 瓊山、臨高諸縣生黎峒首王罰、鐘異、王琳等來朝，命為主簿、巡檢。

translations.literal: Qiongshan, Lingao, and other counties' unacculturated Li dong chiefs Wang Fa, Zhong Yi, Wang Lin, and others came to court; ordered as registrars and inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: Unacculturated Li dong chiefs from Qiongshan, Lingao, and other counties—including Wang Fa, Zhong Yi, and Wang Lin—came to court and were appointed registrars and route inspectors.

sentences.zh: 六年，銘復率土黎峒首王賢祐、王惠、王存禮等來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: Sixth year, Ming again led native Li dong chiefs Wang Xianyou, Wang Hui, Wang Cunli, and others to court, presenting horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Liu Ming again led native Li dong chiefs including Wang Xianyou, Wang Hui, and Wang Cunli to court to present horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 命賢祐為儋州同知，惠、存禮為萬寧縣主簿。

translations.literal: Ordered Xianyou as Danzhou Assistant Prefect, Hui and Cunli as Wanning County registrars.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianyou was appointed Assistant Prefect of Danzhou, and Wang Hui and Wang Cunli registrars of Wanning County.

sentences.zh: 八年，文昌縣斬腳寨黎首周振生等來歸，賜以鈔幣，俾仍往招諸峒。

translations.literal: Eighth year, Wenchang County Zhanjiao Stockade Li chief Zhou Zhensheng and others came to attach; bestowed paper money and silks, and had them still go to summon the various dong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Zhou Zhensheng and other Li chiefs from Zhanjiao Stockade in Wenchang County came over; they were given paper money and silks and sent back to win over the remaining dong.

sentences.zh: 九年，臨高縣典史王寄扶奉命招至生黎二千余戶，而以峒首王乃等來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth year, Lingao County clerk Wang Jifu, ordered to summon, brought over more than two thousand households of unacculturated Li, and dong chief Wang Nai and others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Lingao County clerk Wang Jifu, acting on orders, brought in more than two thousand households of unacculturated Li, while dong chief Wang Nai and others came to court.

sentences.zh: 命寄扶為縣主簿，並賜王乃等鈔。

translations.literal: Ordered Jifu as county registrar, and also bestowed paper money to Wang Nai and others.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jifu was appointed county registrar, and Wang Nai and the others were given paper money.

sentences.zh: 十一年，瓊山縣東洋都民周孔洙招諭包黎等村黎人王觀巧等二百三十戶，願附籍為民。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, Qiongshan County Dongyang District commoner Zhou Kongzhu summoned and instructed Baoli and other villages' Li people Wang Guanqiao and others, two hundred thirty households, who wished to register and become subjects.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Zhou Kongzhu, a commoner of Dongyang District in Qiongshan County, won over Wang Guanqiao and two hundred thirty households of Li from Baoli and other villages, who asked to be registered as ordinary subjects.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 臨高民黃茂奉命招撫深峒、那呆等二十四峒生黎，率黎首王聚、符喜等來朝貢馬，黎民來歸者戶四百有奇。

translations.literal: Lingao commoner Huang Mao, ordered to summon and pacify Shen Dong, Nadai, and twenty-four dong of unacculturated Li, led Li chiefs Wang Ju, Fu Xi, and others to court presenting horses as tribute; Li people who came to attach were more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Mao of Lingao, commissioned to win over the unacculturated Li of twenty-four dong including Shen Dong and Nadai, led Li chiefs Wang Ju and Fu Xi to court with horses as tribute; the Li who came over numbered more than four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 通計前後所撫諸黎共千六百七十處，戶三萬有奇，蓋皆本廟算雲。

translations.literal: Altogether counting front and back those pacified, various Li totaled one thousand six hundred seventy places, households more than thirty thousand odd—all as the court calculated, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Counting all who had been pacified, the Li numbered one thousand six hundred and seventy settlements and more than thirty thousand households in all—as the court's reckoning had it.

sentences.zh: 十四年，王賢祐率生黎峒首王撒、黎佛金等來朝貢，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, Wang Xianyou led unacculturated Li dong chiefs Wang Sa, Li Fojin, and others to court with tribute; the emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Wang Xianyou led unacculturated Li dong chiefs including Wang Sa and Li Fojin to court with tribute, which the emperor graciously accepted.

sentences.zh: 命禮部曰：「黎人遠處海南，慕義來歸，若朝貢頻繁，非存撫意。

translations.literal: Ordered the Ministry of Rites: "Li people dwell far in Hainan south, admiring righteousness and coming to attach; if court tribute is frequent, it is not the intent of cherishing and pacifying."
translations.idiomatic: He told the Ministry of Rites, "The Li live far off in Hainan and have come over out of admiration for the dynasty's virtue; if they are kept coming to court incessantly, that is not what cherishing and pacifying them means."

sentences.zh: 自今生黎土官峒首俱三年一貢，著為令。

translations.literal: From now unacculturated Li native officials and dong chiefs shall all tribute once every three years; established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth unacculturated Li native officials and dong chiefs shall present tribute only once every three years—this was established as a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 」十六年，感恩土知縣樓吉祿率峒首貢馬。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, Ganan native magistrate Lou Jilu led dong chiefs to present horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Lou Jilu, the native magistrate of Ganan, led dong chiefs to court with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年，寧遠土縣丞邢京率峒首羅淋朝貢。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, Ningyuan native assistant magistrate Xing Jing led dong chief Luo Lin to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Xing Jing, the native assistant magistrate of Ningyuan, led dong chief Luo Lin to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 時崖州民以私忿相戰鬥，衛將利漁所欲，發兵剿之。

translations.literal: At the time Yazhou commoners fought each other over private grudges; guard generals profited to fish what they desired and sent troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the people of Yazhou were fighting among themselves over private feuds; guard officers saw profit in the chaos and sent troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 瓊州知州王伯貞執不可，曰：「彼自相仇殺耳，非有寇城邑殺良民之惡，不足煩官軍。

translations.literal: Qiongzhou Prefect Wang Bojian held it impossible, saying: "They are merely killing each other in mutual enmity; they have not the evil of raiding cities and towns and killing good people—not worth troubling the official army."
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Bojian of Qiongzhou objected, saying, "They are simply feuding among themselves. They have not raided towns or slaughtered innocent subjects—there is no need to call out the official army."

sentences.zh: 」衛將不從，伯貞乃遣寧遠縣丞黃童按視。

translations.literal: Guard generals did not follow; Bojian then sent Ningyuan Assistant Magistrate Huang Tong to investigate on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: The guard officers refused to listen, so Bojian sent Huang Tong, the assistant magistrate of Ningyuan, to investigate.

sentences.zh: 果仇殺，逮治數人，黎人遂安。

translations.literal: It proved mutual enmity killing; several people were seized and punished, and the Li people were then at peace.
translations.idiomatic: It proved to be a private feud; several men were arrested and punished, and the Li were pacified.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，樂會土主簿王存禮等遣黎首黎寧及萬州黎民張初等來貢，帝謂尚書胡濙曰：「黎人居海島，不識禮儀，叛服不常，昔專設官撫綏，今來朝，當加賚之。

translations.literal: Xuande first year, Lehui native registrar Wang Cunli and others sent Li chief Li Ning and Wanzhou Li commoner Zhang Chu and others to present tribute; the emperor said to Minister Hu Ying: "Li people dwell on sea islands, not knowing ritual and etiquette; submission and rebellion are inconstant; formerly offices were specially established to pacify them—now that they come to court, rewards should be increased."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande, Wang Cunli, the native registrar of Lehui, and others sent the Li chief Li Ning and Zhang Chu, a Li commoner of Wanzhou, to present tribute. The emperor told Minister Hu Ying, "The Li live on islands at sea and know little of court ritual; their loyalty is uneven. Offices were once set up especially to pacify them—now that they have come to court, they should be rewarded more generously."

sentences.zh: 」九月，澄邁縣黎王觀珠、瓊山縣黎王觀政等聚眾殺瓊山土知縣許誌廣，流劫鄉村，殺掠人畜，命廣東三司勘實討之。

translations.literal: September, Chengmai County Li Wang Guanzhu, Qiongshan County Li Wang Guanzheng, and others gathered crowds and killed Qiongshan native magistrate Xu Zhiguang, raided villages, killed and plundered people and livestock; ordered the Guangdong three offices to investigate truthfully and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wang Guanzhu of Chengmai County and Wang Guanzheng of Qiongshan County, together with others, mustered a mob, killed Xu Zhiguang, the native magistrate of Qiongshan, and raided the countryside, killing people and seizing livestock and goods. The Guangdong provincial administration, judiciary, and military were ordered to verify the facts and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 二年，指揮王瑀等追捕黎賊，兵至金雞嶺，賊率眾拒敵，敗之，生擒賊首王觀政及從賊二百六十二人，斬首二百六十七級，余眾潰，奔走入山，招撫復業黎八百一十二戶，以捷聞，械送觀政等至京。

translations.literal: Second year, Commander Wang Yu and others pursued Li bandits; troops reached Jinjiling, bandits led crowds to resist, were defeated; bandit chief Wang Guanzheng and followers two hundred sixty-two people captured alive, two hundred sixty-seven heads cut, remaining multitude routed, fled into mountains; summoned and pacified eight hundred twelve households of Li who resumed livelihood; victory reported, Wang Guanzheng and others sent to capital in cangues.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Commander Wang Yu and others pursued the Li bandits. When the troops reached Jinjiling the bandits massed to resist and were defeated. The bandit chief Wang Guanzheng and two hundred sixty-two followers were taken alive, two hundred sixty-seven heads were cut off, and the rest fled into the mountains. Eight hundred twelve households of Li were won back and restored to their livelihoods. When victory was reported, Wang Guanzheng and the others were sent to the capital in cangues.

sentences.zh: 帝謂尚書蹇義曰：「蠻性雖難馴，然至為變，必有激。

translations.literal: The emperor said to Minister Jian Yi: "Barbarian nature though hard to tame, yet when they turn to rebellion there must be provocation."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Minister Jian Yi, "Savage peoples are hard to tame, but when they rise in revolt there is always some provocation."

sentences.zh: 宜嚴戒撫黎諸官，寬以馭之，若生事激變，國有常刑。」

translations.literal: Should strictly warn officials who pacify the Li, govern them with leniency; if they create incidents and provoke rebellion, the state has fixed punishments."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a strict warning to all officials charged with pacifying the Li to govern them with forbearance, adding that anyone who provoked trouble and stirred rebellion would face the state's fixed penalties."

sentences.zh: 正統九年，崖州守禦千戶陳政聞黎賊出沒，偕副千戶洪瑜領軍搜捕賊，乃圍熟黎村，黎首出見，政等輒殺之。

translations.literal: Zhengtong ninth year, Yazhou garrison defense battalion commander Chen Zheng heard Li bandits appearing and disappearing, together with Vice Commander Hong Yu led troops to search and capture bandits; then surrounded an acculturated Li village, Li chiefs came out to meet, Zheng and others immediately killed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhengtong, Chen Zheng, commander of the Yazhou garrison defense battalion, heard that Li bandits were raiding back and forth. He and Vice Commander Hong Yu led troops to hunt them down but instead surrounded an acculturated Li village; when the Li chiefs came out to meet them, Chen and his men killed them on the spot.

sentences.zh: 又令軍旗孫得等十五人焚其廬舍，殺其妻孥數人，擄其財物。

translations.literal: Also ordered military bannerman Sun De and fifteen others to burn their dwellings, kill their wives and children several people, and carry off their goods.
translations.idiomatic: They also ordered the soldier Sun De and fifteen others to burn the villagers' houses, kill several of their wives and children, and carry off their property.

sentences.zh: 各黎激變，政及官軍百人，皆為所殺。

translations.literal: The various Li were provoked to rebellion; Zheng and more than one hundred official troops were all killed by them.
translations.idiomatic: The Li rose in fury. Chen Zheng and more than a hundred government troops were killed.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史趙忠以聞，坐瑜激變律斬。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Zhao Zhong reported it; Yu was sentenced by the law on provoking rebellion to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Touring Censor Zhao Zhong reported the affair, and Hong Yu was executed under the statute for provoking rebellion.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年敕萬州判官王琥曰：「以爾祖父能招撫黎人，特授土官。

translations.literal: Jingtai third year edict to Wanzhou Assistant Magistrate Wang Hu: "Because your grandfather and father were able to summon and pacify Li people, you were specially appointed a native official."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingtai an edict addressed Wang Hu, the assistant magistrate of Wanzhou: "Because your grandfather and father were able to win over and pacify the Li, you were specially appointed a native official."

sentences.zh: 爾能繼承父誌，亦既有年。

translations.literal: You are able to continue your father's will, and it has already been several years.
translations.idiomatic: You have carried on your father's work for some years now.

sentences.zh: 茲特降敕付爾，撫諭該管村峒黎人，各安生業，不得仿效別峒生黎所為。

translations.literal: Now specially send down this edict to you, to pacify and instruct the Li people of the villages and dong under your jurisdiction, each to settle in their livelihood, and not imitate what unacculturated Li of other dong do.
translations.idiomatic: This edict is now sent to you to pacify and instruct the Li of the villages and dong under your charge, that each may live in peace and not imitate the conduct of unacculturated Li in other dong.

sentences.zh: 其官軍亦不得擅入村峒，擾害激變。」

translations.literal: Official troops also must not enter villages and dong without authorization, harass, harm, and provoke rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: Official troops likewise must not enter villages and dong without authorization to harass and harm the people and provoke rebellion."

sentences.zh: 天順五年敕兩廣巡撫葉盛，以海南賊五百余占據城池，可馳至瓊，相機撫捕，勿使滋蔓。

translations.literal: Tianshun fifth year edict to the Liang-Guang grand coordinator Ye Sheng, that Hainan bandits more than five hundred occupied cities and walls; should hasten to Qiong, according to circumstances pacify and capture, and not let them spread.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianshun an edict to the Liang-Guang grand coordinator Ye Sheng noted that more than five hundred Hainan bandits had seized towns and ordered him to hurry to Qiong, pacify and capture them as circumstances allowed, and keep the trouble from spreading.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年，崖州故土官陳迪孫、冠帶舍人陳崇祐朝貢。

translations.literal: Hongzhi second year, Yazhou former native official Chen Disun, girdled attendant Chen Chongyou, came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongzhi Chen Disun, the former native official of Yazhou, and Chen Chongyou, a girdled attendant, came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以其能撫黎人之逋逃復業者，厚賜之。

translations.literal: Because they were able to pacify Li people's fugitives who resumed livelihood, richly rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: Because they had been able to bring fugitive Li back to settled life, they were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十五年，黎賊符南蛇反，鎮兵討之，不下。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, Li bandit Fu Nanshe rebelled; garrison troops suppressed them but could not subdue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Li bandit Fu Nanshe rebelled. Garrison troops campaigned against him but could not bring him down.

sentences.zh: 戶部主事馮颙奏：「府治在大海南。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue Principal Clerk Feng Yong memorialized: "The prefectural seat lies south of the great sea."
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yong, a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, memorialized, "The prefectural seat lies beyond the great sea to the south."

sentences.zh: 有五指山峒，黎人雜居。

translations.literal: There is Wuzhi Mountain dong; Li people dwell mixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuzhi Mountain dong the Li live intermixed.

sentences.zh: 外有三州、十縣、一衛、十一所。

translations.literal: Outside are three prefectures, ten counties, one guard, and eleven battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond them lie three prefectures, ten counties, one guard, and eleven battalions.

sentences.zh: 永樂間，置土官州縣以統之，黎民安堵如故。

translations.literal: In the Yongle period, native-official prefectures and counties were established to govern them, and Li people lived in peace as before.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongle reign native-official prefectures and counties were set up to govern them, and the Li lived in peace as before.

sentences.zh: 成化間，黎人作亂，三度征討。

translations.literal: In the Chenghua period, Li people made rebellion; three times campaigns were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chenghua reign the Li rebelled and punitive expeditions were sent three times.

sentences.zh: 將領貪功，殺戮無辜。

translations.literal: Generals greedy for merit killed the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: The generals, greedy for merit, slaughtered the innocent.

sentences.zh: 迨弘治間，知府張桓、余浚貪殘苛斂，大失黎心，釀成今日南蛇之禍。

translations.literal: By the Hongzhi period, Prefects Zhang Huan and Yu Jun were greedy, cruel, and harsh in exactions, greatly losing Li hearts, brewing today's Nanshe calamity.
translations.idiomatic: By the Hongzhi reign Prefects Zhang Huan and Yu Jun had grown greedy, cruel, and harsh in their exactions, alienating the Li and brewing the disaster of Fu Nanshe.

sentences.zh: 臣本土人，頗知事勢，乞仍考原設應襲土官子舍，使各集土兵，可得數萬，聽鎮巡官節制。

translations.literal: Your subject is a native of the region and knows the situation fairly well; beg still to examine the originally established heirs of native offices who should inherit, and have each gather native troops, obtaining several tens of thousands, to be controlled by frontier pacification officials.
translations.idiomatic: I am a native of the region and know the situation fairly well. I ask that the heirs originally designated to succeed the native offices be reviewed and each allowed to gather native troops—tens of thousands could be raised—to serve under the frontier pacification officials.

sentences.zh: 有能擒首惡符南蛇者，復其祖職。

translations.literal: Whoever can capture chief villain Fu Nanshe shall have his ancestral office restored.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever captures the ringleader Fu Nanshe should have his ancestral office restored.

sentences.zh: 以蠻攻蠻，不數月可奏績矣。

translations.literal: Using barbarians to attack barbarians, in not many months success can be reported.
translations.idiomatic: Set barbarian against barbarian, and success can be reported within a few months.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: Edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十九年，總督蔡經以崖、萬二州黎岐叛亂，攻逼城邑，請設參將一員，駐劄瓊州分守。

translations.literal: Jiajing nineteenth year, Grand Coordinator Cai Jing because Yazhou and Wanzhou two prefectures' Li and Qi rebelled and attacked pressing cities and towns, requested establishment of one vice general, stationed at Qiongzhou frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Jiajing Grand Coordinator Cai Jing, citing rebellion among the Li and Qi of Yazhou and Wanzhou that was pressing upon towns and cities, asked that a vice general be appointed and stationed with the Qiongzhou frontier defense command.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，崖州賊首那燕等聚眾四千人為亂，詔發兩廣官軍九千剿之。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, Yazhou bandit chief Na Yan and others gathered crowds of four thousand people to make disorder; edict dispatched Liang-Guang official troops nine thousand to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the Yazhou bandit chief Na Yan and others raised a force of four thousand men. An edict ordered nine thousand Liang-Guang government troops sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 給事鄭廷鵠言：

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zheng Tinghe said:
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zheng Tinghe said:

sentences.zh: 瓊州諸黎盤居山峒，而州縣反環其外。

translations.literal: The various Li of Qiongzhou dwell entrenched in mountain dong, while prefectures and counties lie in a ring outside them.
translations.idiomatic: The Li of Qiongzhou hold the mountain dong, while the prefectures and counties ring them on the outside.

sentences.zh: 其地彼高而我下，其土彼膏腴而我鹹鹵，其勢彼聚而我散。

translations.literal: Their land is high while ours is low; their soil is rich while ours is salty and barren; their force is concentrated while ours is scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Their ground stands above ours, their soil is fertile while ours is salty and poor, their strength is massed while ours is dispersed.

sentences.zh: 故自開郡來千六百余年，無歲不遭黎害，然無如今日甚矣。

translations.literal: Thus from the opening of the commandery for more than one thousand six hundred years, no year passed without suffering Li harm, yet none has been as severe as today.
translations.idiomatic: Thus from the founding of the prefecture more than sixteen hundred years ago there has scarcely been a year without Li raids, yet none has been as grave as the present.

sentences.zh: 今日黎患，非九千兵可辦，必添調狼土官兵，兼召募打手，集數萬眾，一鼓而四面攻之，然後可克。

translations.literal: Today's Li calamity cannot be handled by nine thousand troops; must add Lang and Tu native official troops, and also recruit strike hands, gathering several tens of thousands, and with one drum attack from four sides—only then can it be overcome.
translations.idiomatic: Today's Li crisis cannot be settled with nine thousand men. Lang and Tu native troops must be added, mercenary fighters recruited, and tens of thousands gathered for a single assault from all four sides—only then can victory be won.

sentences.zh: 嘗考剿除黎患，其大舉有二。

translations.literal: Once examined suppressing and removing Li calamity—its major mobilizations have two.
translations.idiomatic: A review of major campaigns to suppress the Li shows two great efforts.

sentences.zh: 元至元辛卯，曾空其穴，勒石五指山。

translations.literal: Yuan to Yuan xinmao year, once emptied their lairs, carved stone on Wuzhi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the xinmao year of the Yuan Zhiyuan era their strongholds were once cleared and a stele was carved on Wuzhi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 其時雖建屯田府，立定安、會同二縣，惜其經略未盡，故所得旋失。

translations.literal: At that time though a garrison-agriculture prefecture was built and Ding'an and Huitong two counties established, regrettably the strategy was not complete, so what was gained was soon lost.
translations.idiomatic: Although a garrison-agriculture prefecture was then established and the counties of Ding'an and Huitong were created, the strategy was not carried through, and what had been gained was soon lost again.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖庚子，又嘗大渡師徒，攻毀巢岡，無處不至。

translations.literal: Jiajing gengzi year, again once crossed troops in force, attacked and destroyed nest ridges, nowhere not reached.
translations.idiomatic: In the gengzi year of Jiajing another great expedition crossed the mountains, destroyed nest villages and ridges, and reached every quarter.

sentences.zh: 於是議者謂德霞地勢平衍，擬建城立邑，招新民耕守。

translations.literal: Thereupon deliberators said Dexia terrain was level and open, planned to build a city and establish a settlement, summon new subjects to farm and guard.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberators then proposed that the terrain at Dexia was level and open, suitable for building a walled settlement and settling new subjects to farm and garrison it.

sentences.zh: 業已舉行，中道而廢，旋為賊資，以至復有今日。

translations.literal: Already begun and carried out, midway abandoned, soon became bandit resources, leading to today's recurrence.
translations.idiomatic: Work had already begun but was abandoned halfway; the site soon became a bandit base, which led to the present crisis.

sentences.zh: 謹條三事：

translations.literal: Respectfully set forth three matters:
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully submit three proposals:

sentences.zh: 一，崖黎三面郡縣，惟東面連郎溫、嶺腳二峒岐賊，實當萬州陵水之沖。

translations.literal: First, Yazhou Li on three sides have prefectures and counties; only on the east they connect with Langwen and Lingjiao two dong Qi bandits, truly facing the thrust of Wanzhou and Lingshui.
translations.idiomatic: First: the Li of Yazhou are bounded on three sides by prefectures and counties, but on the east they link with the Qi bandits of the Langwen and Lingjiao dong, directly threatening Wanzhou and Lingshui.

sentences.zh: 崖賊被攻，必借二峒東訌以分我兵勢。

translations.literal: When Yazhou bandits are attacked, they must borrow the two dong's eastern disturbance to divide our military force.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yazhou bandits come under attack, they will surely stir trouble in those two dong to the east and divide our forces.

sentences.zh: 計須先分奇兵攻二峒，而以大兵徑搗崖賊。

translations.literal: The plan must first divide extraordinary troops to attack the two dong, while the main force directly strikes Yazhou bandits.
translations.idiomatic: We should first detach a flanking force to strike the two dong while the main army drives straight at the Yazhou bandits.

sentences.zh: 彼此自救不暇，莫能相顧，則殲滅可期。

translations.literal: Each side too busy saving itself to care for the other—then extermination can be expected.
translations.idiomatic: With each side too busy saving itself to aid the other, their destruction can be expected.

sentences.zh: 傳聞賊首那燕已入凡陽構集岐賊。

translations.literal: It is rumored bandit chief Na Yan has already entered Fanyang to gather Qi bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Rumor has it that the bandit chief Na Yan has already entered Fanyang to rally the Qi bandits.

sentences.zh: 此必多方誤我，且訛言搖惑，以堅諸部助逆之心。

translations.literal: This must be a stratagem on many sides to mislead us, and also false reports to shake and confuse, to firm the hearts of the various groups aiding rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: This is surely a ruse meant to mislead us on several fronts and spread false reports to stiffen the resolve of rebel allies.

sentences.zh: 宜開示慰安，以解狐疑之黨。

translations.literal: Should openly show reassurance and comfort, to dissolve parties of suspicious foxes.
translations.idiomatic: We should openly reassure and comfort them to break up wavering factions.

sentences.zh: 一，隋、唐郡縣，輿圖可考，今多陷入黎中。

translations.literal: First, Sui and Tang prefectures and counties, mappable and verifiable, today mostly fallen into Li territory.
translations.idiomatic: Second: the prefectures and counties of Sui and Tang times can still be traced on old maps, yet most have now fallen into Li hands.

sentences.zh: 蕩平後悉宜恢復，並以德霞、千家、羅活等膏腴之地盡還州縣，設立屯田，且耕且守。

translations.literal: After pacification all should be restored, and also the rich lands of Dexia, Qianjia, Luohuo, and others wholly returned to prefectures and counties, establishing garrison-agriculture colonies, farming while guarding.
translations.idiomatic: After the region is pacified they should all be restored, and fertile lands such as Dexia, Qianjia, and Luohuo returned fully to prefectural and county control, with garrison-agriculture colonies established to farm and defend at once.

sentences.zh: 仍由羅活、磨斬開路，以達定安，由德霞沿溪水以達昌化。

translations.literal: Still open roads from Luohuo and Mozhan to reach Ding'an, and follow Dexia along stream waters to reach Changhua.
translations.idiomatic: Roads should also be opened from Luohuo and Mozhan to reach Ding'an, and from Dexia along the streams to reach Changhua.

sentences.zh: 道路四達，井邑相望，非徒懾奸銷萌，而王路益開拓矣。

translations.literal: Roads reaching in four directions, wells and towns facing each other—not only awing villains and extinguishing sprouts, but the royal road further opened.
translations.idiomatic: With roads running in every direction and settlements facing one another, we would not only deter wrongdoers at the root but further extend the reach of imperial authority.

sentences.zh: 一，軍威既振，宜建參將府於德霞，各州縣許以便宜行事，以鎮安人心。

translations.literal: First, once military prestige is shaken, should establish a vice-general headquarters at Dexia, and allow each prefecture and county discretionary action, to pacify people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Third: once military prestige has been restored, a vice-general headquarters should be established at Dexia, and the prefectures and counties allowed discretionary authority to steady popular sentiment.

sentences.zh: 其新附之民中有異志者，或遷之海北地方屯田，或編入附近衛所戎籍，如漢徙潳山蠻故事。

translations.literal: Among newly attached people those with divergent intent, either relocate them to Haibei places for garrison-agriculture, or enroll them in nearby guard battalion military registers, as in Han relocating the Tushan Man precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Among the newly submitted, those with rebellious inclinations should either be relocated to garrison-agriculture settlements in Haibei or enrolled in the military registers of nearby guards, following the Han precedent of relocating the Tushan Man.

sentences.zh: 又擇仁明慈惠之長，久任而安輯之，則瓊人受萬世利矣。

translations.literal: Also select long-serving benevolent and gracious chiefs, long in office and pacifying them—then Qiong people will receive benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent and capable officials should also be chosen and kept in office long enough to settle the region—then the people of Qiong will enjoy lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 疏下兵部議，詔悉允行。

translations.literal: Memorial sent down to Ministry of War for deliberation; edict fully approved and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the Ministry of War for deliberation, and an edict approved it in full.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，總兵官陳圭、總督歐陽必進等督兵進剿，斬賊五千三百八十級，俘一千四十九人，奪牛羊器械倍之，招撫三百七十六人。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, Regional Commander Chen Gui, Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijin, and others supervised troops advancing to suppress; cut bandit heads five thousand three hundred eighty grades, captured one thousand forty-nine people, seized cattle, sheep, and weapons twice as many, summoned and pacified three hundred seventy-six people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Regional Commander Chen Gui, Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijin, and others led a punitive campaign, cutting five thousand three hundred and eighty bandit heads, capturing one thousand forty-nine men, seizing twice as many cattle, sheep, and weapons, and winning over three hundred seventy-six people.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝嘉其功，賜圭、必進祿米蔭襲有差。

translations.literal: Victory reported; the emperor praised their merit, bestowed Gui and Bijin salary-rice enfeoffment inheritance with differences.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported, the emperor praised their achievement and granted Chen Gui and Ouyang Bijin graded privileges of salary rice and hereditary enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十四年，長田峒黎出掠，兵備道遣兵執戮之。

translations.literal: Wanli fourteenth year, Changtian Dong Li went out raiding; military defense circuit dispatched troops to seize and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Wanli the Li of Changtian Dong went out raiding, and the military defense circuit sent troops to capture and execute them.

sentences.zh: 草子坡諸黎召眾來報復，戰於長沙營，斬黎首百余級，於是黃村、田尾諸峒黎皆出降。

translations.literal: Caozipo various Li gathered crowds to retaliate; fought at Changsha Camp, cut more than one hundred Li chiefs' heads; thereupon Huangcun, Tianwei, and various dong Li all came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Li of Caozipo mustered a force to retaliate. At Changsha Camp more than a hundred Li chiefs were beheaded, and thereafter the Li of Huangcun, Tianwei, and the other dong all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 瓊州黎人，居五指山中者為生黎，不與州人交。

translations.literal: Qiongzhou Li people—those dwelling in Wuzhi Mountain are unacculturated Li, not interacting with prefectural people.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Li of Qiongzhou, those who live in Wuzhi Mountain are unacculturated Li and have no dealings with the prefecture's settled population.

sentences.zh: 其外為熟黎，雜耕州地。

translations.literal: Outside them are acculturated Li, farming mixed on prefectural land.
translations.idiomatic: Outside them are the acculturated Li, who farm intermixed on prefectural lands.

sentences.zh: 原姓黎，後多姓王及符。

translations.literal: Originally surnamed Li, later mostly surnamed Wang and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: They were originally surnamed Li, but later mostly took the surnames Wang and Fu.

sentences.zh: 熟黎之產，半為湖廣、福建奸民亡命，及南、恩、藤、梧、高、化之征夫，利其土，占居之，各稱酋首。

translations.literal: Acculturated Li's produce—half is wicked people of Huguang and Fujian who fled for their lives, and conscript laborers of Nan, En, Teng, Wu, Gao, and Hua, coveting the soil and occupying it, each calling themselves chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Half the holdings of the acculturated Li were seized by fugitives and desperadoes from Huguang and Fujian and by conscript laborers from Nan, En, Teng, Wu, Gao, and Hua, who coveted the land, settled on it, and styled themselves chieftains.

sentences.zh: 成化間，副使塗棐設計犁掃，漸就編差。

translations.literal: Chenghua period, Vice Commissioner Tu Fei devised plowing and sweeping registration, gradually brought under corvée rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chenghua reign Vice Commissioner Tu Fei devised a scheme of registration and clearance that gradually brought them under corvée rolls.

sentences.zh: 弘治間，符南蛇之亂，連郡震驚，其小醜侵突，無時而息雲。

translations.literal: Hongzhi period, Fu Nanshe's rebellion; the whole commandery was shaken; lesser bandits raided and burst forth without cease, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongzhi reign Fu Nanshe's rebellion shook the whole prefecture, and lesser bandits raided without cease.
